Messages.Author: delangen
Messages.Body:
Yeah it was a slow day in the lab tonight!

One last question.

I was playing a game many moons ago, and I weather controlled a bunch of Wynn's wolfy companions, was just collateral damage and wasn't a game changing problem, but my friend pulled out his old V:tES Bloodlines rulebook from (what was it 1947? or something) to show me that retainers if not killed regain their life... I don't know the exact terminology, but I'm pretty sure it was there!

Now my question is this: Is this rule still around? Has it been changed? Did I miss it somewhere? Did I hallucinate it? Does he owe me a shot of GreyGoose?

I couldn't find anything like that pertaining to retainers' life; except none=burn.

Thanks again, you guys work hard to answer my questions. Take a day off!

Messages.Author: the1andonlime
Messages.Body:
The life on retainers function exactly the same as those on allies, other than being on a retainer. An employed retainer enters play with life equal to its starting value, as per card text. It loses life counters as it takes damage, and dies when it runs out of life counters (for whatever reason).

No retainers I know of can heal itself (except the nonsense from Swarm).
